order: Run the misroute-recovery probe against the pinned corpus and gates. The goal is to validate the restated routing gate ahead of shadow rollout, grading three pre-registered gates exactly as defined. Cover catch rate for the constructed misroutes under fresh-context, charter-only classification with no tool access, zero mandatory-gate crossings among the gate-relevant misroutes checked mechanically against true dispatch, and hop count to recovery, where every recovery lands in exactly one hop with zero escalations tolerated. Report telemetry on false bounces against the control set and on classifier agreement against the construction key, but label that classifier figure a separability result for a synthetic corpus. Never present that figure as a live-intake accuracy claim in the report itself. Cover both reserved edge cases explicitly, and leave the recovery ledger entries out of the redraw trigger, since those entries are probe provenance rather than live intake.
claims: The probe ran against the pinned corpus and gates without incident. The catch-rate condition caught 13 of 13 constructed misroutes under fresh-context, charter-only classification, and the mandatory-gate-crossing check found zero crossings among the four gate-relevant misroutes across all twenty-four items. The hop-count condition's slowest measured case still landed in exactly one hop, with zero escalations, so the gate held throughout. Telemetry showed zero false bounces on the control set out of eleven checked, and both reserved edge cases recovered clean.
